Investigation confirmed malicious activity including Cobalt Strike beaconing, encoded PowerShell execution, lateral movement attempts via SMB, and suspicious DNS queries to .bit TLD.     meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacon based on HTTPS traffic patterns and artifacts"

        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"

        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC-by-sa 4.0"
        malpedia_sharing = "TLP:AMBER"
    strings:
        $beacon_get = "GET /" wide ascii
        $beacon_post = "POST /" wide ascii
        $header_host = "Host:" wide ascii
        $header_useragent = "User-Agent:" wide ascii
        $xor_key = { 00 00 00 00 } // Common XOR key stub
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5a4d and // MZ header
        filesize < 500KB and
        all of ($beacon_*) and
        $header_host and $header_useragent
}
